name: CloudEvents JavaScript SDK
free_limit: Apache-2.0 JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for CloudEvents 1.0: create, serialize, parse, emit and receive structured/binary events using supported protocol bindings, without license fees or event quotas.
watch_out: The SDK runs inside your own Node.js applications and is not a hosted webhook delivery, queue, or broker service. You must supply event receivers, transports, servers and operational infrastructure; third-party messaging, network and cloud charges are separate. Supported bindings vary by transport.
